testcase.name: ids round-trip so a stored setting survives
debian base carries what the coding-agent installers need
bash is always present because every shell session execs it
base and optional sets do not overlap
unknown or missing id falls back to the default rather than throwing
debian is the default and legacy installs are alpine
optional bundle carries the remote-server tooling the shell tool advertises
optional packages are never protected so the Packages tab can remove them
each distro uses its own package manager
